method: Referenced ImageGen edit. The selected PNG is the original returned file.
request:
Edit the first input image, the selected storyboard. Preserve the existing four landscape panel positions in a 2×2 grid, exact original numbered SHOT_ badges, original palette/compositions and actor likeness. The second input is original family visual reference. Dan blue / left watch, Maya plum with ponytail, Nina teal auburn waves, Leo orange, braided Ella in denim overalls, small Max green. A third reference supplies setting or continuity. In every panel actors and props must follow its specified shot precisely. Keep good panels intact. Apply the following specific changes in the artwork. Surgical glove/bench continuity pass. ALL visible characters in every panel wear full-finger sage-green fabric gardening gloves with cream knit cuffs, both hands including the watching children; preserve cuffs and finger shapes. Keep three terracotta pots with three saucers on one single wooden bench: LEFT holds the mint; basil goes into the CENTER; RIGHT stays bare. No planted sticks. In 029 the BOTTOM of Nina's small black basil nursery container is visibly supported, held over bench, with its own nursery tag. In 030 Dan has one empty black container. In 031 there are exactly three dry flat stakes in the dry tray, Ella keeping the tray clear by its rim. In 032 Nina and Leo firm the basil at center; Dan slides the wooden crate under this same bench, which is against the wall. Show two small empty nursery pots INSIDE that crate. Exact cast, protected hands, four labels and original warm light.
SHOT_029 shows only NINA, ELLA, LEO in POTTING_BENCH. Nina turns the basil nursery pot so its own tag faces the family. Ella compares the broader leaves without plucking one; Leo checks the center circle. End: Basil identity confirmed for CENTER; no plant moved yet. Existing artwork error: Nina and Ella barehanded while Nina holds tagged nursery basil. Fix: Restore individual gloves.
SHOT_030 shows only NINA, DAN, MAX in POTTING_BENCH. Nina eases the basil root ball out while Dan takes the empty nursery container. Max points only after Nina’s hands have a secure hold. End: Basil root ball supported above center pot; its empty nursery container in Dan’s hand. Existing artwork error: Nina handles exposed root ball and Dan handles nursery pot barehanded. Fix: Restore gloves on Nina, Dan and Max.
SHOT_031 shows only NINA, MAYA, ELLA in POTTING_BENCH. Nina lowers the single basil root ball into the center hollow. Maya adds damp mix around it while Ella keeps the label stakes dry in the tray. End: One basil plant established CENTER; mint LEFT; RIGHT bare; empty second nursery pot in crate after Dan sets it there. Existing artwork error: Nina and Maya handle soil barehanded, Ella holds blank stakes above crate instead of in dry tray. Fix: Restore gloves and staging of stakes in tray.
SHOT_032 shows only LEO, NINA, DAN in POTTING_BENCH. Leo gently firms the basil’s surrounding soil with Nina’s guidance. Dan shifts the empty crate under the bench, away from the clear path. End: Basil upright and soil settled; crate with two empty nursery containers safely under bench. Existing artwork error: Leo firms soil barehanded; Dan moves crate under a second bench behind separate worktop. Fix: Restore gloves and stage at one wall-side bench.

SHOT_029.observed: Nina supports a tagged black basil pot with gloved hands. Ella points at a broad leaf and Leo watches. The mint is in the left pot and the center is bare.
SHOT_029.correction: Review final likeness, fine detail and individual frame for creator approval.

SHOT_030.correction: Review final likeness, fine detail and individual frame for creator approval.

SHOT_031.correction: Review final likeness, fine detail and individual frame for creator approval.

SHOT_032.correction: Stage the pots and crate at one wall-side bench. Put the crate on its lower shelf below the same tabletop.
